t: This spot on Southwark Street, number 40, once held a two-storey house made of 8,000 paraffin wax bricks. It was called A Pound of Flesh for 50p, or Melting House, and it was made by the British sculptor Alex Chinneck for the Merge Festival. It stood from 26 September to 18 November 2014. A heating apparatus slowly melted it and its roof was lowered as it went. When it had become a pile of hardened goo, it was taken away.
